title: Smooth plateau functions converge weakly to the indicator of an interval
statement: For all real numbers p, q there is a sequence (χ_k)_{k∈ℕ} of C¹ functions ℝ → ℝ with tsupport χ_k ⊆ [p, q] for every k, such that for every Lebesgue-integrable function g : ℝ → ℝ, ∫_ℝ χ_k(α)·g(α) dα → ∫_{(p,q)} g(α) dα as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ p q : ℝ, ∃ χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (χ k)) ∧ (∀ k, tsupport (χ k) ⊆ Icc p q) ∧ ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable g → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ α, χ k α * g α) atTop (𝓝 (∫ α in Ioo p q, g α))
